setup.title: Welcome to ezlauncher
setup.subtitle: Choose where the launcher keeps game files, versions and worlds.
setup.hint: You can change this later in Settings.

versions.offlineRefresh: No internet connection. Still showing the saved list.
versions.noList: The version list hasn't been downloaded yet, and there's no internet connection.

loaders.label: Mod loader
loaders.unsupportedHint: {{name}} isn't available for {{version}}. Pick another loader or version.

play.crashed: {{name}} crashed (exit code {{code}}). Check the game log.
play.needAccount: Create or pick an account to play.
play.needBoth: Pick a profile and an account to play.

log.title: Game log
log.empty: The game's output appears here while it runs.

memory.label: Maximum memory
memory.hint: How much RAM the game may use. 2048–4096 MB suits most vanilla versions.

dataDir.label: Data folder
dataDir.hint: Changing it restarts the launcher. Files are not moved.

errors.OFFLINE: Can't reach Mojang's servers. Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: A download failed. Try again; finished files are kept.
errors.HASH_MISMATCH: A downloaded file was damaged. Try again.
errors.JAVA_UNAVAILABLE: Mojang doesn't provide Java for this computer's system.
errors.INVALID_USERNAME: Usernames are 3–16 characters: letters, numbers and _ only.
errors.VERSION_UNKNOWN: This version wasn't found. Check for new versions and try again.
errors.BUSY: Wait for the install to finish, or cancel it first.
errors.MISSING_FILE: A required file is missing and can't be downloaded. Try Repair.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The server doesn't have this file. Try again later.
errors.BAD_RESPONSE: The server sent something unexpected. Try again later.
errors.LOADER_UNSUPPORTED: This mod loader has no stable build for this version yet.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. See the launcher log for details.
errors.PROFILE_NOT_FOUND: This profile doesn't exist any more.
errors.INVALID_PROFILE: Check the profile's name, version and settings.
errors.VERSION_IN_USE: Profiles or other installs use this version.
errors.WORLD_NOT_LINKED: This world can't be moved because the data folder doesn't support links.
errors.WORLD_NOT_FOUND: This world doesn't exist any more.
errors.MOD_INCOMPATIBLE: This mod doesn't fit the profile's loader or Minecraft version.
errors.MOD_NOT_FOUND: This mod isn't in the library any more.
errors.FILE_CHANGED: The file changed while it was being added. Try again.
errors.MODRINTH_ERROR: Modrinth didn't answer as expected. Try again later.
errors.MOD_DEPENDENCY_MISSING: A mod it needs has no version for this profile.
errors.PLAN_EXPIRED: This search is too old. Search again, then press Download.
errors.MOD_REQUIRED: Another enabled mod needs this one. Untick that mod first.
errors.MOD_NO_SOURCE: This mod can't be downloaded again: its site isn't known, or no longer has this file.

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.notFound: This profile doesn't exist any more.

editor.name: Name
editor.memoryHint: Leave empty to use the global setting ({{mb}} MB).
editor.nothingDownloaded: Nothing is downloaded until you press Play.

changeWarning.title: Change version or loader?
changeWarning.body: Changing the version or loader can break this profile. Worlds opened in an older version can be corrupted, and mods only work with the loader and version they were made for. Back up your worlds first.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteDialog.body: The profile's mods, settings and other files are deleted. Choose what happens to its worlds:
deleteDialog.moveTarget: Profile to move the worlds to

worlds.empty: No worlds yet. Worlds you create in game appear here.
worlds.moveBody: The world will show only in the profile you pick.
worlds.notLinked: This world is stored inside the profile because the data folder doesn't support links, so it can't be moved.
worlds.unassignedBody: These worlds belong to profiles that no longer exist. Give each one a profile to see it again.
worlds.olderWarning: The other profile uses an older version or a different loader.

accounts.label: Account
accounts.renameHint: Renaming keeps the account's UUID, so its progress stays.

versionsPage.title: Installed versions
versionsPage.empty: No versions installed yet. They're installed when you play a profile.
versionsPage.deleteBody: This removes the version's files. Shared files and every profile's worlds and settings are kept.
versionsPage.inUse: Profiles using it will download it again on their next Play: {{names}}
versionsPage.dependents: These installs are built on it and will be deleted too: {{ids}}

mods.title: Mod library
mods.libraryHint: Every mod is stored once here. Tick mods on a profile's Mods tab to use them there.
mods.empty: No mods yet. Add jar files, or drop them here.
mods.drop: Drop .jar files here to add them
mods.removeBody: The mod is deleted from the library.
mods.removeUsed: It is removed from these profiles too: {{names}}
mods.removeUnusedBody: Mods that no profile uses are deleted from the library. You can add them again later.
mods.vanilla: Vanilla profiles can't load mods. Pick Fabric or Quilt on the Settings tab to use mods.
mods.copied: Hard links don't work on this drive, so enabled mods are copied into the profile instead of shared.
mods.locked: {{name}} is needed by {{names}}. Untick those first.
mods.alsoDisabled: Also disabled, as nothing else needs them: {{names}}

remote.title: Add a mod to {{profile}}
remote.noLibraryMatch: No mod with that name in your library.
remote.searchSource: Not in your library. Search Modrinth
remote.notFound: Not found. Only exact names are searched: check the spelling, or try the name from the mod's page.
remote.noVersion: No version for {{game}} with this profile's loader.
remote.missing: Needs {{names}}, which has no version for this profile. Nothing will be downloaded.
remote.incompatible: Doesn't work with {{names}}, enabled in this profile.
remote.nothingToDownload: Everything is already in your library.

validation.checkHint: Also checks every file for damage (takes a moment).

issue.wrongLoader: Made for {{loaders}}, not this profile's loader
issue.duplicateId: Same mod as {{name}}, which is enabled too
issue.java: Needs Java {{range}}, this profile uses Java {{java}}

damaged.unreadable: The file is damaged (it can't be opened)
damaged.sha1: The file is damaged (its contents changed)

unknown.noMetadata: No mod info in the jar: compatibility unknown
unknown.mcVersion: Can't tell which release {{detail}} belongs to

launchProblems.title: Some mods have problems
launchProblems.body: These mods probably won't run as they are.
launchProblems.confirmBody: These mods will be disabled in this profile. They stay in your library, so you can enable them again later.
launchProblems.reasonDependency: needs a mod that gets disabled
launchProblems.loadingPlan: Working out which mods to disable…
launchProblems.warnings_one: Started with {{count}} mod warning. See the Mods tab.
launchProblems.warnings_other: Started with {{count}} mod warnings. See the Mods tab.
